text.text_excerpt: Amazing!!!! So we visited its sister restaurant, Mr. John's, about a year ago and were equally impressed. But my goodness, our experience at Desi Vegas this past weekend was one of the best dining experiences ever. After trying to make last minute reservations (about 2 days prior), we were pleasantly surprised to be accommodated, even though it was for a little later than preferred (the hostess even offered to call us in case they had a cancellation). The restaurant is in a great location, with excellent views of the park across the street (even at night). Compared to its counterpart, Mr. John's, the atmosphere here is brighter and more modern. Grabbed dinner here on our 1st monthly steak night and I was all around impressed. One of the better meals I've had in a bit. The long and short of it: 1. Meat. Everyone said their steak was juicy, tender and cooked to perfection. I got the NY strip medium rare and my friend got the Cowboy Steak medium rare. Both came out actually medium rare (I hate when some places consider slightly pink in the center medium rare). It's definitely the best cut of meat I'd had in awhile. 2. Apps and Sides. The seafood bisque that was a special for the night was amazing. The oysters Rockefeller were decent, but could have used a bit more flavor. Yet another great steakhouse in the city! Mr. John's is great, but surprisingly I had a better experience at Desi Vega! But honestly, you can't go wrong with either restaurant. I came here spontaneously one night because of one of my random steak craving attacks and I'm so glad I made the decision to come. We ordered the Blackened Tuna Napoleon, and Who Dat Shrimp to start off. Both were delicious, but the tuna definitely won over my heart. I couldn't get enough of it. We then ordered the Rib-Eye cooked medium rare. I added the blue cheese crust to mine and sides of the Mac and Cheese, and the Crystal Hot Sauce Onion Rings I've heard so much about.
